c: Open Catalog tasks › Assigned to you, or your groups' list.
say: In the workspace, open the catalog tasks assigned to you, or to your groups.

c: Most hardware goes to Procurement first, then to Field Services.
say: Most hardware goes first to procurement, then to field services to deploy it to the user.

c: Read the item, who it's for and the answers; record progress in Work notes, then Close Task.
say: The task shows the item, who it is for, and the answers. Record progress in work notes, then press close task.

c: Closing the last task lets the item complete.
say: Closing the last task lets the item complete.

c: The classic task form has no assignment group: reassign from the workspace.
say: To reassign a task, use the workspace. The classic form has no assignment group field.
